# State Class View (variant): Field resource technician (state)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**

> Task importance, time share, critical and needed-at-entry values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S): assessment pending (job analysis). A credential gate is shown only when its issuer is verified with a cited source; the other gates are counted, not shown, until the issuer is verified (CR-CP-001 C7).

## Competency targets by role level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)

- Sample and assess vegetation using standardized field protocols — entry L1, journey L2
- Detect and record wildlife by direct observation, sign and standardized surveys — entry L1, journey L2
- Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field — entry L1, journey L2
- Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings — entry L1, journey L2
- Record field observations with protocol fidelity and data integrity — entry L1, journey L2
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — entry L1, journey L2
- Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids — entry L1, journey L2
- Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments — entry L1, journey L2
- Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field — entry L1, journey L2
- Describe, test and sample soils in the field — entry L1, journey L2
- Provide first aid and emergency medical care in remote field settings — entry L1, journey L2
- Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination — entry L1, journey L2
- Apply field biosecurity and decontamination protocols — entry L1, journey L1
- Operate small boats and work safely on water in aquatic, coastal and marine field settings — entry L1, journey L1
- Operate and supervise uncrewed and automated field systems — journey L1
- Deploy, maintain and verify field sensor networks — entry L1, journey L2
- Lead field crews and transfer field judgment to novices — journey L2
- Read site history and reference conditions from landscape evidence — journey L2
- Drive and operate field vehicles safely on unpaved roads and off road — entry L1, journey L2
- Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings — entry L1, journey L2
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — entry L1, journey L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — entry L1, journey L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — entry L1, journey L2
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — entry L1, journey L1
